caption: The drawing features a wooden object with a triangular frame, suspended from the ceiling by a system of ropes and pulleys. The frame holds rows of yellowish straw or broom-like bristles hanging down from its lower edge. The wooden frame is colored brown with a reddish tint and consists of a central rectangular panel and two outer triangular supports connected by three vertical dowels. The ropes and pulleys, shown in brown and gray, are attached to the ceiling beams depicted in soft blue-gray tones. The background is plain, with the focus entirely on the wooden object and the supporting ropes and ceiling structure. One rope extends downward and ends in a loop, indicating an adjustable mechanism. The overall color scheme is naturalistic, with muted browns, yellows, and blues dominating the composition.
title: Swinging Fan
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
